question: How can I customize the client class name when generating a Swift SDK with Fern?
ground_truth: You can customize the client class name by setting the `clientClassName` configuration option in your `generators.yml` file. This allows you to specify a custom name for the generated client class that users will instantiate when using your SDK.

metadata.cited_context: You can customize the behavior of the Swift SDK generator in `generators.yml` by setting the `clientClassName` configuration option. The `clientClassName` parameter is a string that defines "The name of the generated client class. This allows you to customize the class name that users will instantiate when using your SDK."
